name: Shadowmoor
description: Shadowmoor is the dark night aspect of Lorwyn, a mirror-image world of perpetual night, gloom and wild magic.

bio.text: Every three centuries Lorwyn's cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor, and the Great Aurora turned the constantly sunny world into one of perpetual night.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Shadowmoor", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: In Shadowmoor the races, without memory of their previous selves, are transformed and locked in a struggle for survival, so that merrows become thieves and boggarts become feral marauders.

citations.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Merfolk", section "Merrows". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Nissa saw the Aurora sweep over Lorwyn as she made her first planeswalk away from it.

timeline.summary: The Shadowmoor block uses hybrid as its major mechanic, to the point that R&D realizes it overstretched the design space.
timeline.quote: Shadowmoor block used hybrid as the major mechanic

citation.text: "Hybrid mana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona's body is destroyed but her consciousness remains, determined to reclaim her power.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her unforgiving consciousness remained

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overcome by covetousness, Shadowmoor merrows become murderous cutthroats and thieves.
timeline.quote: Overcome by covetousness, Shadowmoor merrows became murderous cutthroats and thieves who steal from the other species of Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Merrows". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rosheen awakes after the Great Aurora has turned Lorwyn into Shadowmoor and searches for Mr. Choppers.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn had become Shadowmoor through the influence of the Great Aurora

citation.text: "Rosheen Meanderer", section "Awakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Aurora transforms Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders.
timeline.quote: The Aurora transformed Nibb and Gyik from mischief-makers into feral marauders.

citation.text: Boggart Arsonists (Shadowmoor, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, turning boggarts into animalistic marauders.
timeline.quote: After the Great Aurora transformed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, the boggarts changed from troublesome tricksters to animalistic marauders.

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Boggarts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gryffid's troops ambush Rhys, the Sapling and Ashling; Rhys talks him out of attacking and Gryffid hurries to protect Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Rhys talked Gryffid out of attacking

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor introduces monocolored hybrid cards, called two-brid.
timeline.quote: Shadowmoor introduced monocolored hybrid cards

citation.text: "Hybrid mana", section "Monocolored hybrid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Devin Low proposes two-brid mana for Shadowmoor to redefine what a hybrid card is.
timeline.quote: Devin Low initially proposed "two-brid" mana for Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Hybrid mana", section "Monocolored hybrid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, making the kithkin furtive and paranoid and turning clachans into douns.
timeline.quote: After the Great Aurora changed the idyllic plane of Lorwyn into the fearful world of Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Kithkin", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Pendulum Year begins as the plane fuses and pockets of Lorwyn sprout in Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Pendulum Year". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora changes Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, turning a constantly sunny world into one of perpetual night.
timeline.quote: But thanks to the Great Aurora , everything's changed.

citation.text: "Shadowmoor", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first of the five kithkin brothers, Wander, is tricked by fae into a swamp and dies from a poisonous mushroom.
timeline.quote: Wander is tricked by fae to go into a swamp, and perishes after eating a poisonous mushroom

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Five Brothers, by Ken Troop". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers' village is later destroyed by cinders because its five most important members died.
timeline.quote: Their village is later destroyed by cinders, because its five most important members died

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Five Brothers, by Ken Troop". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ascaeus finds the river of molten stone but his laugh collapses the cave behind him, and he embraces the river hoping to rekindle.
timeline.quote: In the end, he finds the river, but in his joy, he laughs -- and brings the cave to collapse and cut him off from a way back to surface.

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Paths, by Denise R. Graham". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meme turns out to be an orphaned elf girl raised by a boggart mother.
timeline.quote: Meme is an orphaned elf girl who was adopted and brought up by a boggart mother

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Meme's Tale, by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elves from the wood strike down the boggarts in the showdown against Meme.
timeline.quote: the boggarts are suddenly stricken down by elves from the wood

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Meme's Tale, by Will McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A banshee slays Yasgo's two companions with her howl.
timeline.quote: A banshee slew them with her howl

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Pawn of the Banshee, by Doug Beyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The banshee reveals that Yasgo is only a tacharan, a ghost pawn belonging to her.
timeline.quote: reveals that the boggart is no more than a tacharan, a ghost appearing as a living creature

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Pawn of the Banshee, by Doug Beyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scion kills the Druai on Oona's order for failing and defying her.
timeline.quote: he is slain by the Scion upon Oona's order for failing and defying her orders

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Pawn of the Banshee, by Doug Beyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Valya, protected by her herbs, wakes and kills the banshee; Yasgo fades away.
timeline.quote: kills the banshee by ramming her sword through it

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Pawn of the Banshee, by Doug Beyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Young Gwyb on his first watch sees a dark shape in the water and thinks of the Isleback Spawn, spreading panic through the mindweft.
timeline.quote: During his first watch, the young Gwyb sees a dark shape in the water, and he cannot refrain from thinking about the Isleback Spawn.

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Expedition, by Matt Cavotta". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Virkole attacks treefolk seeking the fire and is overwhelmed and shattered.
timeline.quote: he is overwhelmed and shattered by the treefolk crowd

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Sootstoke, by John Delaney". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lishe collects Virkole's skull for his collection.
timeline.quote: Lishe then walks to the site, collects Virkole's cold skull

citation.text: "Shadowmoor (anthology)", section "Sootstoke, by John Delaney". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Aurora lessens kithkin kindness, deepens their paranoia and dulls their sense of pain.
timeline.quote: The Aurora had lessened the kithkins' kindness, deepened their paranoia, and dulled their sense of pain.

citation.text: Endure (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor's eerie transformation is complete as gloom deepens; selkies, duergar and hobgoblins thrive and drive elves and kithkin back into their strongholds.
timeline.quote: the plane's eerie transformation is complete.

citation.text: "Eventide", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor; features correspond but are changed, such as Kinsbaile becoming Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Kinsbaile became Kinscaer.

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sygg turns to cruel piracy in Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: could recognize Sygg despite his new penchant for cruel piracy

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor sweeps over Lorwyn and transforms Dwynen as she is about to shoot Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dwynen was paralyzed, caught in the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa resists a voice tempting her to stay and, chanting Zendikar, steps through the void and follows a thread home.
timeline.quote: It pulled her with great force through the tear in the fabric of Lorwyn and out into the void.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor's boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders and suffer massive casualties.
timeline.quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the invaders.
timeline.quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Pockets of Lorwyn sprout across Shadowmoor, splitting villages and throwing the plane into turmoil.
timeline.quote: Across Shadowmoor, pockets of Lorwyn sprouted up in the darkness.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor boggarts form the vanguard against the invaders, riding cavalry into enemy lines at great cost.
timeline.quote: The boggarts formed the vanguard, riding their cavalry into the enemy lines and gutting them from within.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor kithkin lead the last charge that destroys the Phyrexian invaders, then shut themselves in their homes.
timeline.quote: it was the isolationist Shadowmoor kithkin that led the last charge to destroy the invaders.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The Hound of Bristlebane skewers a Dominus with a spear along a branch of the Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: singlehandedly drove a spear through the body of a Dominus, skewering it from neck to knee

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor merrow escape to the Dark Meanders to wait out the invasion and adapt to their new environment.
timeline.quote: they escaped to the Dark Meanders, tunnels deep under the plane, hoping to wait out the invasion beneath the water.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow and the darkness transforms the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.
timeline.quote: Everywhere the darkness touched, the city was transformed.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Erewaker crosses into Shadowmoor alone with the sapling, mocked by the faeries, and reaches the clearing with dawnglove.
timeline.quote: Dawnglove ahead. Her journey nearly to its end.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Erewaker performs the Rising ritual in the clearing while the faeries heckle her.
timeline.quote: Once she walks round the clearing. Twice.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The ritual seems to fail, and the faeries urge Erewaker to cast aside her relic.
timeline.quote: Is cast aside your relic.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Erewaker lays down her relic and the sapling takes its first breath.
timeline.quote: The sapling takes their first breath.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: The faeries attack the relic and sapling, and an explosion of magic covers the clearing in dawnglove.
timeline.quote: Dawnglove grows like moss to cover all that it might.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Erewaker realizes the faeries herded the treefolk to this grove and dies as roots pierce her, her sap falling on the mound.
timeline.quote: but they'd been herded, like dogs, to this grove the whole while. To death.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Forget-Me-Not announces the Deffroad Clique's work is done as she dies fulfilling her purpose.
timeline.quote: What a delight it has been to be the Deffroad Clique,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys enters her late uncle Gethin's decayed house and finds the Reliquary of Twilight broken.
timeline.quote: The Reliquary of Twilight hadn't been used much in her uncle's final months

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys finds an unsent letter and a parcel of balsam salve addressed to Rhain Breckon.
timeline.quote: The tag was addressed to a "Mr. Rhain Breckon."

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys writes to Rhain to tell him of Gethin's death and sends the letter and parcel by enchanted paper wing toward the aurora.
timeline.quote: Not left, toward the city of Caer Flur, but right —toward the aurora.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys softens, picks nightphlox for Rhain and sends him a salve recipe; Rhain thanks her.
timeline.quote: Vanity was in Rhain's nature; helping was in hers.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys finds a hidden stem of dawnglove and an unsent letter that shows Gethin almost gave it to Rhain.
timeline.quote: This is what Rhain had asked Uncle Gethin for , she realized

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys asks Rhain if he is dying and he answers that he is.
timeline.quote: Not an hour passed before a reply settled on the desk in front of her.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: A man wished for isolation and Shadowmoor answered.
timeline.quote: He wished for isolation, and Shadowmoor replied.

citation.text: Blossombind (Lorwyn Eclipsed, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jack kills a merrow looter and is saved from Sygg by Brigid, who gives him a wingbow.
timeline.quote: Jack killed one of the Merrow looters and was saved from Sygg's wrath by Brigid's intervention

citation.text: "Jack Chierdagh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Veesa and Iliona help Jack retrieve the scroll and defend him from Oona's loyalists; he is lightly poisoned.
timeline.quote: The fae helped him retrieve the scroll

citation.text: "Jack Chierdagh", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Shadowmoor, Kiel is tracked down and captured by Endry and his groundling troops.
timeline.quote: Kiel was tracked down by Endry and his groundling troops, captured, and put to sleep.

citation.text: "Kiel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Every three centuries Lorwyn's cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: every three centuries, that cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In Shadowmoor the plane's races, without memory of their previous selves, are transformed and locked in a struggle for survival.
timeline.quote: Here, the plane's races, without knowledge of their previous selves, are locked in a life-and-death struggle for survival.

citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The flamekin become smoking skeletons seeking revenge while the vain elves become humbled and heroic.
timeline.quote: the flamekin are now smoking skeletons seeking revenge.

citation.text: "Lorwyn & Shadowmoor". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Isilu is the living embodiment of Shadowmoor.
relations.quote: Isilu is the living embodiment of Shadowmoor and a symbol of the moon.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

relations.quote: There had been no tales of his adventures as a bloomseeker

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

pages_say.description: The darkened, ugly version of Lorwyn after the Aurora, a world devoid of sun.

citation.text: Shadowmoor: card flavor text (Shadowmoor, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The darkened plane after the Aurora, haunted by pucas, gwyllions, noggles, trows and hags.

citation.text: Eventide: card flavor text (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Lorwyn after the Great Aurora, with almost all its memories wiped clean.

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: The dark counterpart of Lorwyn, whose dragons are slumber-disturbed folklore monsters.

citation.work: The Needs of Cards and Beyond
citation.text: "The Needs of Cards and Beyond". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A plane of boggarts, kithkin and canker-ridden tree-witches, used in the column's swearing examples.

citation.text: "Frakkin' Zounds". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A plane drawing on British Isles folklore.

pages_say.description: A plane where every elf is charged from birth to strike back against ugliness and darkness.

citation.text: DCI Promos: card flavor text (DCI Promos, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Plane where the Skybreaker answers every orison.

citation.text: Commander 2011: card flavor text (Commander 2011, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The wave of twisted night that sweeps Lorwyn, changing those it touches.

citation.text: "Nissa's Origin: Home" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2015.

pages_say.description: A plane across which the Skybreaker is called.

citation.text: Eternal Masters: card flavor text (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A plane across which orisons are heard.

citation.text: Commander 2021: card flavor text (Commander 2021, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The nighttime aspect of the plane, a land of dark forests, brambles and eternal night under a cycling moon.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

pages_say.description: The nighttime side of the plane, now spreading into Lorwyn's territories.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

pages_say.description: The night side of the plane, which suddenly descends on Goldmeadow.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.
